Which refund applies to **this order**?

- Order 4417
- Nine days late

options.title: Full refund
options.explanation: The policy covers a delivery this late.

options.title: Store credit

questions.question: When did the parcel arrive? The carrier's record shows no date.

message:
## What this is

Order 4417 arrived nine days late, and the customer asks for a refund.

## What is in and out

- In: refund the order and tell the customer.
- Out: a change to the delivery terms.

## How to do it

Refund the full amount, then send this reply:

```text
We have refunded order 4417 in full. The amount reaches your account within five days.
```

## Why this is the best

The [late delivery policy](https://help.example.com/policies/late-delivery) covers a delivery this late.

## Alternatives

- Store credit: the customer asked for the money back.
